description: Arsenal于1976年推出的旁轴相机。配备Jupiter-8M (ЮРИТЕП-8M), 53mm f/2 standard lens (or Helios-103 53mm f1.8)。快门速度Focal plane slotted type with hinged metal curtains, vertically travelling。Match the rangefinder images, via lens ring or via a wheel in the right-front of the top plate。

specs.镜头: Jupiter-8M (ЮРИТЕП-8M), 53mm f/2 standard lens (or Helios-103 53mm f1.8)
specs.对焦: Match the rangefinder images, via lens ring or via a wheel in the right-front of the top plate
specs.快门: Focal plane slotted type with hinged metal curtains, vertically travelling
specs.取景器: Coupled viewfinder / rangefinder The extreme distance (9 cm) between the windows on the front side, allows for very accurate focusing and makes the camera one of the most accurate rangefinders ever
specs.曝光测光: Uncoupled high-sensitive small-size selenium photo-electric exposure meter, w/ a lid on its window
specs.英文简介: Kiev-4M ( = Киев-4M) is a 35mm rangefinder film camera manufactured by Arsenal Factory, in Kiev, Ukraine, former USSR, and produced between 1976-87.
